visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A woman with short dark hair, wearing a gray zip-up sweatshirt and light-colored shorts, kneels in a modern living room. She holds a compact white THOMSON 2-in-1 dehumidifier. Her facial expressions are animated and smiling. Behind her is a white glass-fronted cabinet and a light-colored brick-patterned wall. (2) Close-up shot of the white dehumidifier sitting on a wooden surface; the product label indicates it is a '2 in 1' unit. (3) The woman demonstrates detaching a slim white dehumidifier box from the top of the main unit. She holds the box toward the camera with a cheerful expression. (4) A montage showing the dehumidifier box placed in various household locations: a walk-in closet with hanging clothes, a bathroom near a sink, a shoe cabinet filled with boots and sneakers, a kitchen snack cupboard with snacks, and a highly organized electronics drawer. (5) The woman demonstrates placing the slim box back into the docking slot on top of the main unit to recharge/dry it. A blue indicator light glows on the device. (6) The woman holds the unit again, gesturing towards it, while graphic overlays with promotional text and price offers appear on screen.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video aims to promote the THOMSON 2-in-1 dehumidifier by highlighting its versatility, particularly the detachable drying box that can be used in small spaces like closets and drawers, and emphasizing its value through a limited-time discount.
